findings.title: Evaluation reads gave a share holder every user's runs of a shared agent
findings.quote: rows, truncated = db.evaluation_window_rows(since=lo, until=hi, agents=names, caller=caller)
findings.description: trinity-enterprise#875 narrows a person an agent is only shared with to the executions they started (viewer_own_rows / viewer_row_scope). The evaluation reads scope by accessible_agent_names alone, and every row this epic writes grades one execution.
findings.exploit: User B is shared agent X by its owner A. B calls GET /api/agents/X/evaluations/indicators/checks_passed/runs (or the MCP get_evaluation_summary tool, or /evaluations/failed). The response lists execution ids, schedule ids, delegating agents, failure reason codes and costs of A's runs; GET /api/agents/X/executions/{id} 404s the same ids for B.
findings.impact: Run metadata (not content) of other users' runs disclosed across the share boundary ent#875 closed.
findings.recommendation: Carry viewer_own_rows through the evaluation ReadScope and apply it on every read.
findings.resolution: Fixed on the branch: f193da467. ReadScope carries viewer_own_rows; window, cost and list queries take one SQL condition; per-execution and by-id reads check the run's starter; the chain stops at another user's run; the stored trend reads empty for a narrowed caller. Pinned by tests/unit/test_936_share_holder_own_runs.py (red before the fix on every route).
findings.verifier: independent agent (security-analyzer, fresh context) found it; re-derived in context from dependencies.py:3188 and routers/evaluations.py
